    ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.RelTensor.gram_cstarMatrix_nonneg

    Unconditional Hilbert C*-module Gram-matrix positivity #

    Composes the three committed pieces into the unconditional statement: the Gram matrix of a finite family of vectors in a right Hilbert A-module is positive in CStarMatrix's spectral order.

    gram_posSemidef (Matrix.PosSemidef, from the module quadratic form) ∘ cstarMatrix_ofMatrix_nonneg_of_posSemidef_of_quadratic_bridge (conditional on the module-positivity bridge) ∘ cstarMatrix_nonneg_of_isSelfAdjoint_of_forall_inner_toCLM_nonneg (the bridge, CFC posPart/negPart).

    This is the 0 ≤ G that feeds relForm_nonneg (B3.1-b-ii) of the Connes-fusion relative tensor.

    source
    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.RelTensor.gram_cstarMatrix_nonneg {A : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [SMul A E] [Norm E] [CStarModule A E] {I : Type u_3} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (e : I → E) :
    0 ≤ CStarMatrix.ofMatrix fun (i j : I) => inner A (e j) (e i)

    The Hilbert C*-module Gram matrix G i j = ⟪e j, e i⟫_A (in the orientation delivered by cstarModule_gram_quadratic_nonneg / gram_posSemidef) is positive in CStarMatrix's spectral order, unconditionally.
